title: 科创与晶圆代工开盘确认，港股仍弱，天孚回购遭负反馈 + 美股盘前：PPI前期指近乎持平，CBRS与NVDA反弹；微软中断及高利率压制
summary: 截至09:31 CST，上证、深证、创业板和科创50分别涨0.11%、0.26%、0.41%和1.89%，恒指跌0.72%、恒生科技跌0.32%。中芯国际A/H涨2.44%和4.23%，华虹宏力A/H涨5.74%和4.22%，双市场确认业绩与回购催化并升级为看多候选；天孚通信再跌2.86%、连续弱于CPO同业，降为回避。证监会第三批互换便利1000亿元补强稳市与回购主题托底。 06:33 ET，道指期货涨0.05%、标普500期货涨0.15%、纳指100期货跌0.03%；10年期美债收益率约5.13%，08:30 ET的PPI是加息路径关键。NVDA盘前反弹2.6%，CBRS因上调收入预期及新增微软客户涨逾17%；MSFT因全球服务中断跌2.1%，AMD、AVGO与加密链承压。今日没有已确认的大型盘后科技财报样本。

重大新闻汇总
国际
胡塞武装袭击沙特能源设施推升油价
也门胡塞武装称袭击沙特东西输油管道泵站、延布石油设施及利雅得阿美建筑；沙特方面称拦截两架无人机。布伦特原油结算涨3.3%至95.82美元，能源链获支撑，但航空、化工与输入性通胀承压。 来源
国际
英伟达下跌压过能源上涨，美股小幅收低
英伟达CEO黄仁勋离任后股价收跌4.3%，盘中一度跌近12%；道指、标普500和纳指分别跌0.36%、0.35%和0.39%，能源板块涨1.5%。下降家数明显多于上涨家数，AI风险偏好尚未修复。 来源
政策
央行重申适度宽松并支持科技创新与“六张网”
2026年第三季度货币政策执行报告提出保持流动性充裕和社会融资条件相对宽松，并加强对扩大内需、科技创新、中小微企业与“六张网”建设的金融支持。政策托底有利于估值稳定，但不能替代公司盈利与价格确认。 来源
政策
证监会第三批互换便利1000亿元强化稳市支持
证监会披露证券、基金公司已开展第三批互换便利操作1000亿元，并将支持上市公司加大回购增持力度、拓宽中长期资金入市渠道。该首轮遗漏信息强化宽基与回购主题托底，但个股仍需价格确认。 来源
政策
发改委按机制调整国内成品油价格
国家发改委11月12日公告称，本轮调价参考的前10个工作日国际原油均价低于上轮。该政策口径与隔夜原油随后因中东风险急升形成时点差，今日炼化、航空与运输成本判断应优先观察最新油价和本地开盘反应。 来源
市场
A股科技开盘确认、港股宽基仍弱
截至09:31 CST，上证、深证、创业板和科创50分别涨0.11%、0.26%、0.41%和1.89%；恒指跌0.72%、恒生科技跌0.32%。晶圆代工显著跑赢宽基，市场判断由“全面风险偏好转弱”收窄为“A股科技结构确认、港股继续承压”。 来源
科技

11月12日美股现金时段，油气炼制、独立电力行业分别涨2.13%、1.66%；光通信概念涨3.33%，代表股AVGO涨5.54%；太阳能行业跌5.25%。A/H映射优先看油气、公用事业、CPO与光伏开盘强弱，不以美股主题涨幅直接推导买入。 来源
科技
AI治理冲击扩散至云计算与数据中心
NBIS跌16.8%、CRWV跌6.9%，IREN和APLD分别跌6.5%和5.4%，费城半导体指数跌0.5%。AMD、AVGO与Alphabet逆势上涨，但竞争替代仍需订单和A/H本地价格验证。 来源
公司
中芯国际业绩后获A/H双市场确认
中芯国际第三季度收入31.90亿美元、毛利率29.9%，产能利用率97.3%；截至09:31 CST，A股涨2.44%、港股涨4.23%，均为业绩披露后的有效交易时段，且跑赢科创50与恒生科技，升级为看多候选。 来源
公司
华虹回购注销获A/H同步价格确认
华虹宏力拟3亿至5亿元回购A股并全部注销，价格上限255.55元；截至09:31 CST，A股涨5.74%、港股涨4.22%，公告后双线均显著跑赢宽基，升级为看多候选。监管豁免和股东会批准仍是执行风险。 来源
公司

天孚通信11月12日首次回购10万股、耗资1454.34万元；前一交易日跌2.58%，截至09:31 CST再跌2.86%，而中际旭创涨0.21%、新易盛涨1.03%。连续且相对板块更弱的反馈否定短线看多，降为回避。 来源

美股夜盘行情总结

宽基
夜盘指数
截至08:50 CST，本轮对QQQ、SPY、DIA延长时段代理的查询未返回可核对的同一时点报价，检索到的摘要时间互相冲突，故明确记为不可得；不以11月12日现金收盘的纳指-0.39%、标普-0.35%、道指-0.36%冒充当前夜盘。
代表股
板块对照
确认：CLNE +5.32%、ONEN +6.38%、MERC +11.97%、SKYQ +3.81%、BTU +3.02%延续能源/电力强势；AVGO +5.56%、DVN +2.85%、NAAS +1.82%确认光通信、页岩油/天然气与充电桩方向；JAGU -1.55%、AZUL -8.69%、SVM -2.82%确认对应弱势。背离/潜在反转：BETR +1.98%对抵押贷款金融-4.71%形成背离，ZEO +13.29%对太阳能-5.25%构成潜在反转；各报价时间为06:35–08:23 CST的最新可得成交。
映射
A/H 映射
开盘后晶圆代工成为最清晰确认：中芯与华虹A/H双线跑赢宽基；光通信则分化，天孚逆势下跌。能源映射尚未形成同等强度的公司级确认。短线优先采用本地开盘价格而非隔夜主题外推；若中芯、华虹跌回前收下方或天孚重新站上前收并跑赢板块，当前结论失效。

盘前结论

事实层面，09:31 CST上证、深证与创业板小幅上涨，科创50涨1.89%；恒指与恒生科技分别跌0.72%和0.32%。A股科技结构获得开盘确认，但港股宽基与科技仍未同步转强。

中芯国际A/H分别涨2.44%和4.23%，华虹宏力A/H分别涨5.74%和4.22%，均在公告后的有效交易时段跑赢比较基准。晶圆代工业绩与回购注销已由“条件线索”升级为双市场价格确认。

证监会第三批互换便利1000亿元强化稳市与回购主题托底；但天孚通信再跌2.86%，连续弱于CPO同业。光通信不能因美股主题上涨而整体外推，天孚降为回避。若科创50转跌、晶圆代工跌破前收或港股科技弱势扩大，正面确认失效。

重点个股关注

中芯国际
688981.SH / 00981.HK
看多候选

事实与状态：第三季度收入31.90亿美元、毛利率29.9%、产能利用率97.3%；截至09:31 CST，A股涨2.44%、港股涨4.23%，均为业绩披露后的有效价格确认，并跑赢科创50与恒生科技。

确认条件：A/H双线维持前收上方，且不持续弱于科创50或港股半导体；业绩说明会不下修四季度收入环比增长4%-6%的指引。

风险与失效条件：毛利率四季度指引26%-28%低于三季度，AI治理冲击仍可能压低估值；任一市场跌破前收且持续弱于板块时撤销看多。

华虹宏力
688347.SH / 01347.HK
看多候选

事实与状态：拟以3亿至5亿元回购A股并全部注销，价格上限255.55元；截至09:31 CST，A股涨5.74%、港股涨4.22%，公告后双线均显著跑赢宽基。

确认条件：A/H股保持前收上方并延续相对半导体板块强势，监管豁免与股东会审批路径未出现负面变化。

风险与失效条件：回购方案仍需批准且可能调整；若高开后跌回前收以下或成交放大但价格转弱，撤销看多。

天孚通信
300394.SZ
回避

事实与状态：首次回购10万股、耗资1454.34万元并拟注销；前一交易日跌2.58%，截至09:31 CST再跌2.86%，而中际旭创涨0.21%、新易盛涨1.03%，连续出现板块相对负反馈。

确认条件：仅在重新站上前收140.34元、成交与价格同步改善且持续跑赢通信设备同业后重评。

风险与失效条件：回购规模相对总股本有限，股价若继续弱于CPO同业或跌破早盘低点，回避结论强化。

板块轮动看板

受益方向晶圆代工获业绩与回购双催化，并由中芯、华虹A/H同步价格确认。
观察方向稳市工具与能源方向提供托底，但需持续强于宽基；CPO仅保留分化观察。
压力方向天孚通信连续弱于同业；英伟达相关AI云、太阳能及港股宽基仍承压。
验证信号科创50维持正收益，中芯与华虹守住前收；天孚未收复前收前不重评。

逻辑链

中芯业绩与华虹回购 → 公告后A/H双线走强 → 晶圆代工成为开盘最清晰确认方向。
科创50涨1.89%、港股科技跌0.32% → 科技风险偏好并非全面修复 → 优先公司级催化而非泛科技追涨。
美股光通信涨3.33% → A股CPO同业分化 → 天孚连续走弱 → 主题映射不能替代本地价格反证。
第三批互换便利1000亿元与回购支持 → 宽基下行风险获托底 → 仍以成交与前收得失验证持续性。

风险雷达

英伟达领导层变化与AI融资审视仍可能压低高估值科技链。
中东冲突与高油价抬升运输、化工和通胀压力，利率风险可能反复。
港股宽基仍弱，恒指与恒生科技未同步A股科技修复。
天孚连续弱于CPO同业，回购事件不足以抵消负面价格反馈。
AKShare快照仍为11月11日旧基线，今日盘中判断仅使用明确标时的公开延迟报价。

数据来源与时间点

首轮截止2026-11-13 08:41 CST；增量复核截至09:31 CST，共识别2项实质增量并全部进入正文。新增/遗漏核验：证监会原始页面、财联社与证券时报交叉源；开盘行情：东方财富公开延迟报价API，行情时间09:31 CST。国内发现源沿用金十、财联社与东方财富，法定来源包括证监会、国家发改委、HKEX及公司公告。排行：GitHub Actions/Moomoo 08:37:28 CST，对应11月12日美股现金时段。AKShare v1.18.94 fetchedAt 11月11日14:23:09 CST，仅作旧基线，不冒充今日盘中行情。

Major News
Global
Houthi attacks on Saudi energy sites lift oil
Yemen's Houthis said they attacked a pumping station on Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline, an oil facility in Yanbu and an Aramco building in Riyadh; Saudi forces said two drones were intercepted. Brent settled 3.3% higher at $95.82, supporting energy while pressuring airlines, chemicals and inflation-sensitive assets. Source

Nvidia drop outweighs energy gains as US stocks slip
Nvidia closed 4.3% lower after CEO Jensen Huang's departure and fell nearly 12% intraday. The Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq lost 0.36%, 0.35% and 0.39%, while energy gained 1.5%. Decliners substantially outnumbered advancers, so AI risk appetite remains fragile. Source

PBOC reiterates an appropriately accommodative stance
The Q3 2026 monetary-policy report called for ample liquidity and relatively loose social-financing conditions, with more support for domestic demand, technology innovation, SMEs and the “six networks.” This helps valuation stability but does not replace earnings or price confirmation. Source

CSRC deploys RMB100 billion third swap-facility operation
The CSRC said securities and fund firms have begun a RMB100 billion third swap-facility operation, alongside stronger support for listed-company buybacks and broader long-term capital channels. This first-round omission reinforces broad-market and buyback support, but stock selection still requires price confirmation. Source
Policy
NDRC adjusts domestic fuel prices under the mechanism
The NDRC said on November 12 that the 10-working-day average of international crude used for this adjustment was below the prior window. That reference predates the overnight Middle East-driven oil spike, so today's refining, airline and transport view should follow the latest oil and local opening reaction. Source

Mainland technology confirms while Hong Kong stays weak
At 09:31 CST, the Shanghai Composite, Shenzhen Component, ChiNext and STAR 50 were up 0.11%, 0.26%, 0.41% and 1.89%; the Hang Seng fell 0.72% and Hang Seng Tech 0.32%. Foundries materially outperformed broad indices, narrowing the view from broad risk-off to mainland tech confirmation with continued Hong Kong pressure. Source

In the November 12 US cash session, Oil & Gas Refining and Independent Power Producers gained 2.13% and 1.66%; Optical Communication rose 3.33%, led by AVGO at +5.54%; Solar fell 5.25%. The A/H mapping is to oil, utilities, CPO and solar opening strength, not an automatic buy signal. Source

US Overnight Trading Summary

Broad
Overnight indices
As of 08:50 CST, the current-run queries for QQQ, SPY and DIA extended-hours proxies did not return a verifiable same-time snapshot; retrieved snippets carried conflicting timestamps and are therefore marked unavailable. The November 12 cash closes — Nasdaq -0.39%, S&P 500 -0.35% and Dow -0.36% — are not presented as live overnight quotes.
Leaders
Sector comparison
Confirmation: CLNE +5.32%, ONEN +6.38%, MERC +11.97%, SKYQ +3.81% and BTU +3.02% extend energy/power strength; AVGO +5.56%, DVN +2.85% and NAAS +1.82% confirm Optical Communication, Shale Oil/Natural Gas and EV Charging; JAGU -1.55%, AZUL -8.69% and SVM -2.82% confirm weak groups. Divergence/potential reversal: BETR +1.98% diverges from Mortgage Finance -4.71%, while ZEO +13.29% is a potential reversal against Solar -5.25%. Latest available trade times span 06:35–08:23 CST.
Mapping
A/H mapping
After the open, foundries provide the clearest confirmation: SMIC and Hua Hong outperform broad indices in both A and H shares. Optical Communication is mixed, with TFC Optical falling against the theme, while energy lacks equally strong company-level confirmation. Local opening prices take priority over overnight extrapolation; the view fails if SMIC/Hua Hong lose prior close or TFC Optical retakes it with sector outperformance.

Pre-market View

At 09:31 CST, the Shanghai Composite, Shenzhen Component and ChiNext were modestly positive and the STAR 50 gained 1.89%; the Hang Seng and Hang Seng Tech fell 0.72% and 0.32%. Mainland technology has opening confirmation, but Hong Kong broad and technology indices have not turned in sync.

SMIC A/H shares gained 2.44% and 4.23%, while Hua Hong A/H shares gained 5.74% and 4.22%, all in the first valid post-announcement session and ahead of their comparison indices. Foundry results and cancellation-buyback catalysts now have cross-market price confirmation.

The CSRC's RMB100 billion third swap-facility operation reinforces market and buyback support, but TFC Optical fell another 2.86% and lagged CPO peers for a second session. The strong US optical theme cannot be extrapolated across the A/H chain; TFC Optical is downgraded to Avoid.The positive view fails if the STAR 50 turns negative, foundries lose prior close, or Hong Kong technology weakness deepens.

Stocks to Watch

SMIC
688981.SH / 00981.HK
Bullish Candidate

Facts and status: Q3 revenue was $3.190 billion, gross margin 29.9% and utilisation 97.3%. At 09:31 CST, A shares gained 2.44% and H shares 4.23%, providing valid post-results confirmation and outperforming the STAR 50 and Hang Seng Tech.

Confirmation: Both lines remain above prior close without sustained underperformance versus the STAR 50 or Hong Kong semiconductors, and the briefing does not cut the Q4 revenue-growth guidance of 4%-6% sequentially.

Risk and invalidation: Q4 gross-margin guidance of 26%-28% is below Q3, while AI governance risk may compress valuation. Remove the bullish stance if either line falls below prior close and stays weaker than its sector.

Hua Hong Semiconductor
688347.SH / 01347.HK
Bullish Candidate

Facts and status: The company plans a RMB300-500 million A-share buyback for cancellation, capped at RMB255.55. At 09:31 CST, A shares gained 5.74% and H shares 4.22%, both materially outperforming broad indices after the announcement.

Confirmation: Both lines stay above prior close and retain semiconductor-relative strength, with no adverse change to the regulatory-waiver or shareholder-approval path.

Risk and invalidation: The plan still needs approval and may be adjusted. Remove the bullish stance if the gap reverses below prior close or volume rises while price weakens.

TFC Optical Communication
300394.SZ
Avoid

Facts and status: The company bought 100,000 shares for RMB14.5434 million and intends cancellation. It fell 2.58% in the prior session and another 2.86% by 09:31 CST, while Zhongji Innolight gained 0.21% and Eoptolink 1.03%, creating persistent sector-relative negative feedback.

Confirmation: Reassess only after it retakes the RMB140.34 prior close with improving price/volume and sustained outperformance versus communication-equipment peers.

Risk and invalidation: The first purchase is small versus total shares. Further CPO-relative weakness or a break below the morning low reinforces Avoid.

WatchStabilisation tools and energy support the floor but must keep outperforming broad indices; CPO remains selective.
PressureTFC Optical continues to lag peers; Nvidia-linked AI cloud, Solar and Hong Kong broad indices remain pressured.
ValidationThe STAR 50 remains positive and SMIC/Hua Hong hold prior close; do not reassess TFC Optical before it retakes prior close.

Logic Chain

SMIC results plus Hua Hong buyback → both A/H lines rise after disclosure → foundries become the clearest opening confirmation.
STAR 50 +1.89% but Hang Seng Tech -0.32% → technology risk appetite is not broadly repaired → favor company catalysts over generic tech chasing.
US Optical Communication +3.33% → mixed A-share CPO peers → persistent TFC Optical weakness → theme mapping cannot override local counterevidence.
RMB100 billion third swap facility plus buyback support → downside risk gains a policy floor → sustainability still depends on volume and prior-close retention.

Risk Radar

Nvidia leadership change and scrutiny of AI financing may keep compressing high-valuation technology chains.
Middle East escalation and high oil raise transport, chemical and inflation risks, potentially reviving rate pressure.
Hong Kong broad indices remain weak and have not matched the mainland technology rebound.
TFC Optical continues to lag CPO peers; the buyback event does not outweigh negative price feedback.
The AKShare snapshot remains an old November 11 baseline; today's intraday view uses only clearly timestamped public delayed quotes.

Sources and Timestamps

First-run cutoff: 2026-11-13 08:41 CST; incremental review through 09:31 CST identified two material additions, both entered into the brief. New/omitted evidence: original CSRC page cross-checked with CLS and Securities Times; opening quotes: Eastmoney public delayed quote API with a 09:31 CST market timestamp. Domestic discovery remains Jin10, CLS and Eastmoney; statutory sources include the CSRC, NDRC, HKEX and company filings. Rankings: GitHub Actions/Moomoo at 08:37:28 CST for the November 12 US cash session. AKShare v1.18.94 fetched 2026-11-11 14:23:09 CST and is historical context only, not today's intraday data.

治理
NVDA盘前反弹2.6%
英伟达在周内截至周四累计跌约11%后反弹；价格反馈转正，但CEO离任、政治审视与融资关系检查仍使其属于高波动修复。 来源
云服务
微软全球中断拖累MSFT
Outlook、Teams和Copilot中断超过12小时，MSFT盘前跌2.1%，是“七巨头”中唯一明显下跌者；负反馈使其不进入多头卡。 来源
财报
CBRS上调预期并新增微软客户
Cerebras将2026年调整后收入预期上调至9.40亿至9.60亿美元，并披露微软云计算协议；股价盘前涨逾17%，基本面催化与价格反馈同向。 来源
财报
CSCO盈利创纪录并上调全年指引
Cisco季度收入185亿美元、非GAAP EPS 1.40美元，均创纪录；公司把FY27 AI基础设施收入目标提高至90亿美元，并上调全年收入与EPS指引。盘前价格反馈未保持强势，降为观察。 来源
财报
AMAT收入与指引均超预期
Applied Materials季度收入104.1亿美元、调整后EPS 4.16美元；下一季收入指引中值111亿美元高于一致预期108.9亿美元。尽管基本面强，板块扩散有限，不追高。 来源
芯片
AMD与AVGO回吐竞争替代涨幅
两股盘前均跌逾1.5%，显示昨日相对NVDA的竞争替代交易没有连续确认；芯片链仍以个股催化而非全面反弹为主。 来源
加密
比特币与加密股继续走弱
比特币触及约三个月低点，COIN、MSTR与MARA盘前跌1.4%至2.6%；高利率与风险偏好收缩形成双重压力。 来源
宏观
PPI决定加息幅度再定价
市场已完全计入12月加息，50基点加息概率约12%；08:30 ET的10月PPI若偏热，长端利率与高估值科技将再承压。 来源
能源
油价连续第三日上涨
特朗普表示美国不需要与伊朗达成协议后，油价延续上涨；能源获得相对支撑，但更高油价也增加通胀与运输成本风险。 来源

盘前结论

事实层面，PPI公布前期指接近平盘，10年期收益率约5.13%、美元偏强继续抬高估值压力；NVDA与CBRS获得正反馈，但MSFT、AMD、AVGO和加密链仍弱。

判断层面，开盘更可能是指数横盘、个股剧烈分化，而非AI全面反弹。优先关注催化与价格同向的CBRS；NVDA仅按战术修复处理。

不确定性集中在08:30 ET的PPI、微软服务恢复和英伟达治理后续。若PPI偏热或NVDA/CBRS高开失守，交易将重新转向成长股去风险。

重点个股推荐

Cerebras Systems
CBRS
财报强势

推荐理由：上调全年调整后收入预期并新增微软客户，盘前涨逾17%，催化与价格反馈一致。

触发因素：开盘后守住主要跳空区，并维持高于盘前常态的成交承接。

风险点：数据中心容量约束、政策变化与高波动估值；高开回落会削弱信号。

Nvidia
NVDA
反弹观察

推荐理由：周内大跌后盘前反弹2.6%，价格反馈转正且成交关注度高。

触发因素：开盘后继续高于前收并相对纳指与芯片指数走强。

风险点：CEO更替、政治审视、出口限制与融资关系检查尚未结束；仅作修复交易观察。

Chevron
CVX
能源防御

推荐理由：油价连续第三日上涨，CVX盘前约涨0.9%，在科技分化时呈现防御性正反馈。

触发因素：油价维持强势且CVX开盘后继续跑赢标普500。

风险点：伊朗局势缓和或油价回落会迅速削弱催化；能源并非低波动资产。

Walmart
WMT
防御强势

推荐理由：盘前约涨0.9%，在PPI前与科技不确定性中体现消费防御相对强度。

触发因素：守住正涨幅并继续强于道指与零售板块。

风险点：估值不低，11月19日财报前预期较高；宏观数据偏热可能压制估值。

板块轮动看板

强势观察CBRS财报跳涨、NVDA修复、能源防御与WMT相对强势。
事件驱动08:30 ET PPI、微软服务恢复进度及英伟达治理后续。
压力方向MSFT、AMD、AVGO、加密链，以及利好后未获持续正反馈的CSCO/AMAT。
验证信号10年期收益率能否回落、纳指能否转强、CBRS能否守住跳空。

逻辑链

PPI待公布 + 10年期收益率约5.13% → 加息幅度仍可再定价 → 高估值科技反弹受限。
NVDA周内重挫后盘前反弹2.6% → 抄底资金入场 → 只有开盘后持续跑赢芯片指数才确认修复。
CBRS上调收入预期并新增微软客户 → 盘前涨逾17% → AI算力需求仍强但交易集中于个股。
微软中断 + AMD/AVGO回落 + 加密链下跌 → 风险偏好仍脆弱 → 开盘基准情形是指数横盘、内部剧烈分化。

盘后财报 beat 概率

说明

风险雷达

PPI若高于预期，50基点加息概率与长端收益率可能跳升。
英伟达领导层、政治与出口审视可能再次打断NVDA及AI链反弹。
微软服务中断若持续，可能从情绪冲击转为企业生产率与客户信任问题。
部分盘前报价来自公开延迟源，量能未能逐只独立核验；所有卡片需开盘后确认。

数据来源与时间点

行情截点：2026-11-13 06:33–07:33 ET（北京时间19:33–20:33）。主要来源：Reuters、Cisco与Applied Materials公司公告、公开延迟盘前报价、MarketWatch利率数据及S&P 500/Nasdaq 100财报日历。期指和部分个股报价有延迟；截点时PPI尚未公布，个股量能未全部独立核验。

Cisco reported record quarterly revenue of $18.5 billion and non-GAAP EPS of $1.40, raised its FY27 AI-infrastructure target to $9 billion, and lifted full-year revenue and EPS guidance. Premarket feedback did not stay strong, so it remains a watch. Source

Applied Materials reported $10.41 billion in revenue and adjusted EPS of $4.16; the next-quarter revenue midpoint of $11.1 billion topped the $10.89 billion consensus. Despite strong fundamentals, sector follow-through was limited, so avoid chasing. Source

Both fell more than 1.5% premarket, showing that yesterday's competitive-substitution trade versus NVDA lacked follow-through. Chips remain stock-specific rather than a broad rebound. Source

Bitcoin hit a roughly three-month low, while COIN, MSTR and MARA fell 1.4%-2.6% premarket. High rates and shrinking risk appetite create a double headwind. Source

PPI can reprice the size of the next hike
Markets fully price a December hike, with roughly 12% odds of a 50-basis-point move. A hot October PPI at 08:30 ET would renew pressure on long yields and high-duration technology. Source
Energy
Oil rises for a third session
Oil extended gains after President Trump said the US did not need a deal with Iran. Energy gains relative support, but higher oil also raises inflation and transport-cost risks. Source

Pre-market View

Fact: futures are nearly flat before PPI, while the 10-year yield near 5.13% and a firm dollar keep valuation pressure elevated. NVDA and CBRS provide positive price feedback, but MSFT, AMD, AVGO and crypto remain weak.

Judgment: the opening setup is more likely to be flat indices with sharp stock-level dispersion than a broad AI rebound. Favor names where catalysts and price agree, especially CBRS, while treating NVDA as a tactical repair.

Uncertainty centers on the 08:30 ET PPI, Microsoft service restoration and Nvidia governance. A hotter PPI or a failed NVDA/CBRS gap would shift the setup back toward growth-stock risk reduction.

Stocks to Watch

Cerebras Systems
CBRS
Earnings strength

Reason:Raised adjusted full-year revenue guidance and added Microsoft as a customer; shares rose over 17% premarket, aligning catalyst and feedback.

Trigger:Hold most of the opening gap with participation above its normal premarket baseline.

Risk:Data-center capacity constraints, policy changes and volatile valuation; a gap fade would weaken the signal.

Nvidia
NVDA
Rebound watch

Reason:Rebounded 2.6% premarket after a sharp weekly drop, turning price feedback positive with heavy attention.

Trigger:Stay above prior close and outperform both the Nasdaq and the chip index after the open.

Risk:CEO transition, political scrutiny, export controls and financing reviews remain unresolved; treat only as a repair trade.

Chevron
CVX
Energy defense

Reason:Oil rose for a third session and CVX gained about 0.9% premarket, providing defensive positive feedback amid tech dispersion.

Trigger:Oil holds firm and CVX continues to outperform the S&P 500 after the open.

Risk:Iran de-escalation or an oil reversal would quickly weaken the catalyst; energy is not low volatility.

Walmart
WMT
Defensive strength

Reason:Gained about 0.9% premarket, showing defensive consumer strength before PPI and amid tech uncertainty.

Trigger:Hold the positive move and continue to outperform the Dow and retail peers.

Risk:Valuation is not cheap and expectations are elevated before November 19 earnings; hot macro data could compress multiples.

Sector Rotation Board

StrengthCBRS earnings gap, NVDA repair, energy defense and WMT relative strength.
Catalysts08:30 ET PPI, Microsoft service recovery and Nvidia governance developments.
PressureMSFT, AMD, AVGO, crypto, and CSCO/AMAT where good news lacked durable positive feedback.
ValidationWhether the 10-year yield eases, Nasdaq turns higher and CBRS holds its gap.

Logic Chain

PPI pending + 10-year yield near 5.13% → rate-hike size can still reprice → high-duration tech rebounds stay constrained.
NVDA rebounds 2.6% after a sharp weekly drop → dip buyers return → repair is confirmed only with post-open chip-index outperformance.
CBRS raises revenue guidance and adds Microsoft → shares rise over 17% → AI-compute demand remains strong but the trade is stock-specific.
Microsoft outage + AMD/AVGO pullback + crypto weakness → risk appetite remains fragile → base case is flat indices with sharp internal dispersion.
